summary: Cycle-1250 (99a82b3c, REVERTED console-first 2026-08-03) injected sig.Generic['run_dir.artifact_bytes']=dirSize(workspace) unconditionally into router.Digest. routingtest's keystone (TestSignalSpec_DualRenderingAgree: pure rendering MUST equal Digest extraction from ONE fixture) can never pass against a runtime-computed value the fixture cannot model — main red 5 commits, both platforms, while per-cycle changed-scope gates never selected routingtest. The telemetry intent is GOOD (artifact-size signals feed budget/routing decisions). Re-land it the framework's way: SignalSpec gains ArtifactBytes; the orchestrator rendering writes it from the run dir; the PURE rendering emits it from the spec; the keystone stays green because both sides derive from the fixture. Alternative if size must stay runtime-truthful: a non-signal telemetry channel (phasetiming), never Digest.Generic.
